'''Wannes Van Laer''' (born 5 March 1985 in [[Ostend]]) is a professional Belgian [[sailing (sport)|sailor]].<ref name="OlympicBotGeneratedRef">{{cite web|title=Wannes Van Laer|url=http://www.london2012.com/athlete/van-laer-wannes-1128999/|website=London2012.com|publisher=[[The London Organising Committee of the Olympic Games and Paralympic Games Limited]]|access-date=13 September 2012|url-status=dead|archive-date=11 September 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120911224441/http://www.london2012.com/athlete/van-laer-wannes-1128999/}}</ref> He competed at the [[2012 Summer Olympics]] in the [[Sailing at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Men's Laser class|Men's Laser class]], where he finished in 34th place.{{refn|name=London 2012 Results - Laser - Men|{{cite web|title=Olympic Results: London 2012, Sailing, Laser - One Person Dinghy men|url=http://www.olympic.org/olympic-results/london-2012/sailing/laser-one-person-dinghy-m}}}} Since 2013 he became Belgian Champion [[Laser (dinghy)|Laser Standard]] for the sixth time.

Van Laer sails under the colours of the [[French Community of Belgium|Wallonia-Brussels Federation]], for the [[Fédération Francophone du Yachting Belge|FFYB]].

==World ranking==
Highest position on the [[International Sailing Federation|ISAF]] world ranking so far (updated: 17 juni 2013): '''16th'''<ref>[http://www.sailing.org/rankings_table.php?includeref=ranking22666&rankdiscipline=2&ranktype=2&rankclass=64&rankdate=latest ISAF World Ranking - Men - Laser]</ref>
